title: Onboard azura-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Samantha Ortiz
description: This PR adds the initial onboarding for azura-13b v1.0 into the model registry and wires up automated changelog entries that surface perf profile metadata. Motivation: teams need a canonical metadata entry and validated performance profiles so the serving runtime and Optimize tooling can make informed decisions (kernel selection, quantization recommendations, and routing policies). This change includes: 1) model metadata JSON with versioning, config, supported quantization profiles, and compatibility notes; 2) performance profiles for standard instance classes (g4dn, p4d, and dedicated NVMe-backed pools) with token/sec baselines and latency P95 measurements; 3) updates to the changelog generator to automatically include perf_profile summaries and the perf baseline comparison when a new model version is added; 4) an integration test that verifies generated changelog entries include perf diffs and that perf profiles pass sanity checks against expected ranges. Implementation notes: - Metadata is placed under model-registry/models/azura-13b/v1.0/metadata.json following the existing schema. - Perf profiles are YAML files under the same directory and include machine-readable fields (instance_type, batch_sizes, seq_lengths, tokens_per_sec, latency_p95_ms, quantization_profile). - The changelog generator scripts were extended to read perf_profiles/* and produce a release_notes fragment under changelogs/auto/. This fragment is consumed by the docs pipeline. - Tests: added tests/model_registry/test_azura_perf.py that run lightweight synthetic workloads and assert no regression vs. baseline thresholds. - No runtime code changes to serving; this is registry + automation + tests only. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata + perf profiles - [x] Validate schema with model-registry CI - [x] Add changelog automation + unit tests - [x] Add docs page draft for azura-13b - [x] Get approvals and merge
